name: Jasper
tagline: Wild Rockies, glacier highway and dark skies
summary: Jasper is a laid-back mountain town in the largest national park of the Canadian Rockies, wilder and quieter than Banff. Drive the Icefields Parkway past glaciers, cruise Maligne Lake to Spirit Island, explore Maligne Canyon and stargaze in a dark-sky preserve.
seasonNote: June to September for lakes and hiking; the Icefields Parkway can close in winter storms.
arrival: 4 hours from Edmonton airport or a scenic VIA Rail journey.
gettingAround: A car is essential; shuttles in summer.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 15 to 20 percent. Sales tax is added at the till.
